S3: 403 for the unnamed staff seat; 400 INVALID_GROUP; the sample with the request as typed and no address; one audit row ops.usage.read-turns. S4: the moment undo is the turn's (fromSiteChanges); restores 1, row reverts 1 — the chat revert is not counted. S5: the older site counts as created and for first requests, never as a site nobody opened; with no visit recorded yet, nothing is counted as opened. S6: Token totals, coverage, partial counts and nearest-rank medians match SQL for 24h, 7/14/30 days, All time and custom dates; median is absent at 19 and present at 20. Missing tokens stay null and recorded zero stays zero. The leaderboard always excludes staff/demo and sitesChanged counts distinct changed site incarnations. Current and previous values use equal observed bounds.
